property_summary: For any caller and any amount, the reference contract's fallback only accepts (does not revert) when msg.value == 10 ether; the mutant changes this acceptance to msg.value == 5 ether, so there exist fuzzed amounts where the reference rejects but the mutant accepts (or vice versa).
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when fallback accepts and sets pastBlockTime.
